title: Americana Folk Art Autumn Prints
author: Scrapbook Attic Studio
description:
Set of 12 Colonial Americana Folk Art Autumn Prints “Pumpkin Farm”
Bring the timeless charm of early America into your seasonal decor with this beautifully curated set of Colonial Americana Folk Art “Pumpkin Farm” Autumn Images. Each digital print captures the nostalgic spirit of harvest time rendered in warm, watercolor earthy tones and vintage folk art style.
Perfect for Thanksgiving, farmhouse decorating, or crafting, these high-resolution 300 DPI images come sized at 14 x 11 inches but are easy to resize to fit your needs—ideal for printable wall art, seasonal signs, junk journals, cards, or DIY fall projects. Whether you’re curating cozy gallery walls or creating heirloom-style prints, these digital downloads bring historical warmth to any space.
✔️ What You Get:
12 Colonial Americana autumn folk art images
300 DPI high-resolution JPGs
Sized at 14″ x 11″ (landscape orientation)
Easy to resize and crop in Canva, Photoshop, or any photo editor
Instant download—print at home or through your favorite print shop
Add a touch of rustic American heritage to your fall season with this unique collection of artfully vintage digital prints.
🍁 Perfect For:
Thanksgiving wall decor
Colonial and primitive farmhouse themes
Autumn scrapbooking and junk journaling
Seasonal card making
Cozy gallery wall arrangements
DIY crafts and home decor
Vintage-style fall printables for your Etsy shop or personal projects
Bring historical warmth and rustic elegance to your home or creative projects this fall with these beautiful Colonial Americana art prints.
Please Note:
Colors may vary depending on monitor and printer settings
